raw_definitions: Definisi : go ~, seiring: love and marriage go ~ like a horse and carriage, kasih sayang dan perkahwinan adalah seiring spt kuda dgn pedati. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ with, berserta, bersama dgn: I’m sending you the book, ~ with some clothes that you left behind, saya akan mengirimi kamu buku itu berserta pakaian yg tertinggal; this news ~ with the information we received yesterday should convince the jury, berita ini bersama dgn maklumat yg kami terima semalam seharusnya meyakinkan pihak juri; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 8. with one another, bersama: they’ve decided to get back ~ for the children’s sake, mereka memutuskan utk kembali hidup bersama demi kepentingan anak-anak mereka; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : 7. in unity, menyatukan: all that mattered to him was keeping the family ~, yg penting baginya adalah menyatukan keluarganya; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 6. in continuous sequence, terus: he would work for days ~ and then take a few days off, dia akan terus bekerja berhari-hari lamanya dan kemudiannya bercuti utk beberapa hari; he would sit for hours ~, doing nothing, dia akan terus duduk berjam-jam lamanya dgn tdk membuat satu apa pun; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 5. combined, sama-sama: he was smarter than the other two put ~, dia lebih bijak drpd kedua-dua orang itu digandingkan sama-sama; ~ these factors have brought about disunity among the party members, faktor-faktor ini sama-sama membawa perpecahan di kalangan ahli-ahli parti; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 4. not far from each other, in close proximity, rapat-rapat: antelopes like to group ~ in large herds, kijang suka berkumpul rapat-rapat dlm satu kawanan yg besar; the girls were all standing close ~, budak-budak perempuan itu semuanya berdiri rapat-rapat; the glasses were placed ~ at the side of the table, gelas-gelas diletakkan rapat-rapat di tepi meja itu; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 3. so as to be in contact or united, sekali: he tied the two ends ~, dia mengikat kedua-dua hujung itu sekali; mix the ingredients ~, campurkan bahan-bahan itu sekali; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 2. at the same time, simultaneously, serentak: they were not all singing ~, mereka semua tdk bernyanyi serentak; all his troubles seem to come ~, nampaknya segala kesusahannya datang serentak; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : adv 1. conjointly, in corporation, sama-sama: we all went ~ in the one car, kami semua sama-sama pergi dlm satu kereta; the two scientists are working ~ on the experiment, kedua-dua ahli sains itu sama-sama membuat uji kaji tersebut; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
